statements.status_notes: The vendored source backports the final Logrus v1.9.3 Writer scanner behavior: the denial-of-service remediation introduced by upstream commit 6acd903758687c4a3db3c11701e6c414fcf1c1f7 and its empty-token panic correction from d40e25cd45ed9c6b2b66e6b97573a0413e4c23bd. The repository regression test writes consecutive 128 KiB lines and fails against the unpatched scanner.

statements.impact_statement: The preserved vendor tree contains only the ECR, STS, credential, request, signing, and supporting protocol packages required by this component. The vulnerable S3 encryption client package is neither vendored nor linked into the executable.
